detail: The station-continuation contract's Movement step 1 specifies three apron REGULATION lines ('THRUST COLD · CLAMPS ENGAGED.', 'PRESSURE EQUALIZING.', 'ENTRY REQUIRES A DESIGNATION RECORD · PROCEED TO COUNTER.'). A repo-wide grep for CLAMPS / EQUALIZ / 'ENTRY REQUIRES' under main/ returns zero matches. These lines are contracted but not shipped.

ch11/ch12 exist only as milestone namespaces. They have no StoryBeat entries, no BeatContract, no chapter-registry entry, no journey declaration, no rail, and no autopilot coverage. STORY_BEAT_ORDER terminates at 'done' and the station/return sit entirely outside it. Consequently ?story=<beat> deep links, movie mode, beat-flow timing, and the beat-contract test suites do not reach the station visit or the hearth restoration at all.

installTidegardenBondedCell marks story:ch12-bonded-cell-installed and story:ch12-hearth-restored but emits no caption, system line, or audit line. The interaction verb 'Install the Sealed Bonded Cell' and the marker clearing are the only player-visible acknowledgment of the hearth being restored. This is the terminal act of the R12 sidecar.

No authored cue, mood, motif, or silence ownership exists for the station visit or the return/install. storyScore.ts moods cover beats only, and the station page is a separate Vite entry with no audio imports. SpaceStationLighting.tsx names a 'future station-audio packet' that does not exist.

The only rendered audio evidence in this range is dated 2026-08-12, is score-only rather than combined, covers ch10 beats only, and predates the in-flight audio-10x engine work. Both relevant audio-report.md files are unfilled templates ('template_incomplete'). There is no human-listened validation of any beat in this range on disk.

Bell's opening line is not a fixed authored string — it resolves from vendor.persona.greeting in the procedural vendor table, with a hardcoded fallback only in StationStoryPanel.tsx. The one required-dialogue speaker in the station visit therefore has a non-deterministic first line.

.codex/production-runs/2026-09-05-after-the-hearth/ is routed to the story council before scene production. Its README records that no runtime or canon changes were made and that the candidate is being prepared elsewhere. Its story-side artifacts (scene-contract.json, director signoffs, verification-report.json, final-scorecard.json) were NOT opened in this role and their pass/fail state is unknown to this packet.

No filesystem mtimes were obtained (read-only tool set, no shell).
